card.name: Space before a dose amount
card.fires_on: The space right after a drug name or a dosing-table label, just before the dose number (e.g. 25 mg). It is most common in premedication and dosing tables.

modes.label: Space after drug name
modes.description: The gap between a drug name such as dexamethasone or diphenhydramine and its dose amount.

modes.label: Space after a table label
modes.description: The gap after a heading or amount word, before the number to be taken.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words about taking or consuming something by mouth, such as intake, ingestion and oral.
card.plain: It fires at the gap just before a dose number, where the text is about to say how much to take.
